title: Amrutha Varshini
desc: Abhishek falls in love with Veena, who is married to Hemanth. Things begin to swirl out of control when an obsessed Abhishek decides to kill Hemanth to get him out of the way.

title: Beautiful Manasugalu
desc: Inspired by true events, the story revolves around innocent lovers Prashanth and Nandini, who suffer due to the TRP-driven media, that thrives on sensationalism and not truth.

title: Aranmanai 3
desc: Jyothi, the daughter of a landlord, gets haunted by an unknown entity in her childhood. However, when the spirit begins to trouble another member of her family, she decides to uncover its identity.

title: Thavarina Siri
desc: Muttanna bravely navigates life's challenges to provide for his family while staying true to his humanitarian heart. Despite their struggles, he selflessly takes care of others.

title: Doddmane Hudga
desc: Surya, estranged from his wealthy family after being ignored by his father, returns years later to protect their land from a vile villain.
